_note: Integrity lens, round 1, carousel no. 71, returned by carousel-scorer and saved in shape. Its hard fail was verified against govtech.com's robots.txt on November 8th and the deck was re-sourced.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Rendered staged scenes with dark fields. Slide 6's face-on sheaf does not draw the 57 against the column; slide 9 keeps its review's defects; slide 8 is grey middle; slide 7 half empty with a slab edge; kit people read as mannequins.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one key, one parcel, the bluebonnet motif works, the column carries 6 into 7. Slide 8's room sits outside the street vocabulary.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Numerals trace, but 30 of 44 claims came from www.govtech.com, which names ClaudeBot Disallow / and which the project refused on October 26th and 30th. Slide 6 draws a 57 of 20,000 comparison; the frame order invites a funnel; slide 2's 'here bulk trash participation' infers past the source; 'The still' presents a render as the camera's image; the first comment omits ids the caption uses.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where, who spoke and the money land. The committee is unnamed, no budget date, the close is small.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, the turn at 6. Slide 4 is movable and the close lands softly.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and specific. 'The sheet is a drawing unit.' and the caption's meta line read flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A residential street, office and council room diverge from nos. 67 to 70; the staged world, a stacked counter and camera surveillance a week after no. 64 are familiar.

hard_fails.fail: Every Dallas Morning News fact was fetched from www.govtech.com, a host whose robots.txt names ClaudeBot with Disallow / and which this project refused on October 26th and 30th.
hard_fails.evidence: SOURCES_FIELD_LOG.md 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-30; topics.json no. 63; claims c14 to c42 and c44.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The 57 sheaf is a face-on board with no thickness and the officer looks down in a shell vest.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Turn the clipboard edge-on so the sheaf reads as a sliver beside one bundle at the column's base, and pitch his head up.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grass through the walk, a riser notch, a brick seam and an oversized board on a mannequin resident.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Exclude the walk from the grass, close the notch, and scale the notice to letter size held in both hands.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat grey slabs on mid-tone wood, the tabs indistinct, the chairs unlit.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Narrow the key to a raking slit across the ledge and drop the dais front to near black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A narrow column with a half empty frame and slab edge seams at the bottom.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dolly in so the column fills the right third and extend the ground so no slab edge shows.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A front-lit mannequin officer in a shell vest and a pile with little contact.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Turn him three quarters away with a rim on his back and seat the pile and tires in the key's pool.
